editorial.blurb: PhoLicious is a bustling Vietnamese gem where expertly crafted broths, tender meats, and vibrant flavors justify the wait—locals keep returning for the P6 pho and crunchy banh mi.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive during off-peak hours to avoid long waits at this popular spot; ask your server for the P6 pho recommendation, which comes loaded with a quarter pound of brisket and all the goodness.

topDishes.note: Might be the best pho of your life, loaded with a quarter pound of brisket
Huge portion of soft shell crab on crunchy bread with a flavorful kick
Perfectly cooked short rib with super flavorful broth and thin, light noodles
